segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so on Brightline Parts, they came back at 84 seats, not 90. Finance cut six warehouse supervisors from phase one.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Does that change the quote materially, or are we still inside the tier from the pricing sheet?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Still inside the 75 to 100 tier. Annual comes to $58,800 before the services line. I put $6,500 for onboarding, two remote workshops, and admin training.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good. Are they still asking for April 15 go-live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: April 22 now. Their ops lead is out the first week of April, so they want the import done by the 12th and a week of testing.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Makes sense. Any blockers on paper?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Just the data retention addendum. I’ve pinged security and legal a couple times for the exception approval, and the deal is basically parked until that sign-off comes back.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Did procurement accept net 30, or are they pushing net 45 again?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They accepted net 30 if we invoice on signature, not on go-live. I updated that in the billing tool notes so there’s no surprise.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Nice. Once the addendum clears, send me the final order form and I’ll check the seat count and dates before you route it.
